_comment: Build order for the L5R character sheet. recombine.py concatenates every
`file` below, in this order, and writes the single-file HTML the app has
always been. Nothing is transformed on the way through -- the output is
`lines` records where each fragment came from in the pre-split deliverable.
split.py uses it to carve the original up; recombine.py ignores it entirely.
It is kept as provenance, so any fragment can be traced back to the exact
lines of the build it was cut from.
Adding a source file means adding an entry here, in the position it should
occupy. Order in this list IS the build order.
The fragments under src/sheet/ are pieces of ONE IIFE, not modules. They are
concatenation units: no fragment parses as standalone JavaScript, and none
is meant to. Splitting the IIFE into real modules would mean changing the
sheet's logic, which this phase explicitly does not do.

PART H Phase 1 - UI/UX foundations (scroll-to-top, Ring affinity/deficiency accent). New in this phase, not carved from the original monolith -- no `lines` provenance applies.
PART H Phase 2 - Quick-Access Sidebar (a toggleable read-only panel, not a pinned side rail -- see the phase's README). New in this phase -- no `lines` provenance applies.

PART H Phase 9 - Clan-themed look (per-Clan colour override of the existing --shu* tokens, plus mon watermark/colophon art -- see the phase's README). New in this phase -- no `lines` provenance applies.

PART G Phase 3 - Smart Roll Preview (gates rollWithModifiers() behind a pre-roll modal showing the pipeline's own projected pool, plus in-preview Void spending -- see the phase's README). New in this phase -- no `lines` provenance applies.

PART G Phase 4 - "Explain This Roll" (turns the base-pool parts each caller now declares on the roll context into breakdown rows, shown alongside Phase 3's modifier rows in both the preview and the result -- see the phase's README). New in this phase -- no `lines` provenance applies.

PART J Phase 5 - Character Creation Linting (a CharacterValidator of nine discrete rule functions built over the sheet's own deciding code, plus the ValidationReport panel under the XP breakdown on the Identity tab -- see the phase's README). Numbered 209.5 rather than 211 because 210 CLOSES the sheet's IIFE: every src/sheet fragment must build before it, so a higher number would sort after the file it has to precede. New in this phase -- no `lines` provenance applies.

PART J Phase 8 - Casting Diagnostics ("Why can't I cast this?"). A CastingDiagnosticEngine built as an OPEN registry (registerCastingDiagnostic), modelled on PREROLL_MODIFIER_REGISTRY, so Part G Phase 6's SynergyEngine can add or suppress reasons later without this fragment being edited -- see the phase's README. Numbered 209.7 for the same reason Phase 5 is 209.5: 210 closes the sheet's IIFE, so every src/sheet fragment must build before it. New in this phase -- no `lines` provenance applies.

PART I Phase 4.5 - Modal-Configured Advantages/Disadvantages. The config schema for the variable entries (Elemental Blessing's Ring pick, Lord Moon's Curse's severity tier), the AdvDisadvEffect resolver, the picker modal, and the Trait XP discount recalcAll() subtracts. The schema is name-keyed INSIDE this fragment rather than added as fields on ADV_LIBRARY's rows, so deleting this file deletes the whole feature -- see the phase's README. Numbered 209.8 for the same reason Phase 8 is 209.7: 210 closes the sheet's IIFE, so every src/sheet fragment must build before it. New in this phase -- no `lines` provenance applies.
